title: Mobility Equipment Manufacturer Labor Schedule — Warranty Battery-Set Replacement
content:
# Warranty Battery-Set Replacement — Labor Claimed from the Manufacturer

**Schedule clause.** Summit Ridge claims from the chair manufacturer the labor of every battery-set replacement done under the manufacturer's battery warranty on a Mobility Equipment chair, in whole 15-minute units, and posts that claim on the repair job. The units claimed for a warranty battery-set replacement are the standard battery-set allowance of 2 units.

## The unit

| Labor units | Minutes of labor |
|---|---|
| 1 | 15 |
| 2 | 30 |

Units are whole numbers; the claim is never stated in fractions of a unit or in minutes.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A battery set on a Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) is replaced under the manufacturer's battery warranty. The labor claimed from the manufacturer on that repair job is 2 units, that is 30 minutes of labor.

## Points of the clause

- **From whom is the labor claimed?** From the chair manufacturer.
- **Where is the claim posted?** On the repair job of the battery-set replacement.
